feed: SallyIP public benchmark metrics — validation closeout PROPOSAL (NEW FILE; in-place rewrite of public/benchmarks/latest.json DEFERRED per read-only constraint)
read_only_note: This file is a NEW-FILE-ONLY proposal. public/benchmarks/latest.json was read (34 metrics, verified parse) but NOT modified. To promote: review diff, then copy over latest.json in a write-enabled session and re-validate with scripts/verify-benchmark-data.mjs.
head_note: Tree dirty at draft (see git status --short); a clean checkout/tag is required before any submission — see benchmarks/vals-readiness.md §6.
rules: Sections are never merged into one score; see benchmarks/external-scoreboard.md for the five-section presentation.
No 5-question smoke test may populate a 100-question headline: consumers MUST respect sample_size and headline_eligible before quoting any metric.
Only numbers sourced from the repo artifacts listed in each metric's methodology_url are included; anything else is status PENDING or BLOCKED with null numerator/denominator/percentage.
Mechanical grader verdicts are regression signals, not lawyer review and not publications.
No EXTERNAL_PUBLIC, PRACTITIONER_GRADED or THIRD_PARTY metrics exist yet; placeholders record that explicitly.

Schema: requested closeout fields (benchmark_name, benchmark_version, sample_size, numerator, denominator, percentage, model, provider, commit, run_date, status, methodology_url) PLUS legacy linkage (id, metric, source, run_id, headline_eligible, sample_note) so no audit trail is lost. Status vocabulary mapped VERIFIED_INTERNAL -> INTERNAL_FROZEN.
